P1: RETURNS: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Unopened items in original packaging receive a full refund to the original payment method. Opened items that are not defective receive store credit for 50% of the price paid (after any discounts). Defective items receive a full refund or a replacement. Final-sale items cannot be returned for change of mind, but damaged-in-transit claims (P6) and warranty claims (P4) still apply to them. Return shipping is paid by the customer, except for defective or damaged items.
P2: SHIPPING: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days and costs $5.99, and is free on orders of $50 or more (before tax). Express shipping takes 2 business days and always costs $14.99. Orders placed before 2 PM Eastern Time on a business day ship that same business day. We do not ship internationally.
P3: CANCELLATIONS: Orders can be canceled for free before they ship. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be canceled; the customer must wait for delivery and use the returns policy (P1). Refunds for canceled orders arrive within 3-5 business days.
P4: WARRANTY: Electronics and small appliances have a 12-month warranty from delivery. Furniture has a 24-month warranty from delivery. The warranty covers manufacturing defects only, not accidental damage or misuse. Valid claims are resolved by repair, replacement, or refund, at BrightCart's discretion.
P5: LOYALTY: Members earn 1 point per $1 spent on merchandise (before tax and shipping). 100 points can be redeemed for a $5 reward. Points expire after 12 months with no earning or redeeming activity. Only one discount code can be used per order, but points can be redeemed in addition to a code.
P6: DAMAGED OR LOST ITEMS: Damage must be reported within 7 days of delivery, with photos, and the customer may choose a replacement or a refund. Late reports are handled under the returns policy (P1) or warranty policy (P4). If tracking shows no movement for 7 days or more, BrightCart will reship the item or refund it, at the customer's choice.
